\rI won't do it…anymore!\nI'll never do anything…like that…again!\nSo please…Forgive…Forgive me.
\bCourtney.\nI, the great Maxie, will forgive you.\nBut only on one condition!
\bCourtney. I never imagined…\nI never could have imagined…
\bHow very loyal you were to me.
\bNor did I imagine even one iota of the shock you must have experienced, due to my recent speech and conduct, or how I could have pained you.
\bThe one who drove you to such an extreme act was me.
\bYou see, Courtney, I would like to start on a new path.
\bThere are truths that I have learned because of the mistakes I have made.
\bThey pit me against others who are not like me and against ideas that differ from mine.
\bThey tell me the importance of understanding these others, even though we may continue to cause pain to another.
\bAnd that holds true whether the opponent I face is human, Pokémon, or even the might of nature itself.
\bI will take this step forward, free from hesitation, and meet my foe.
\bAnd together we will find a way to create, not destroy. Or so I hope.
\bThat is the vision that I, Maxie,\nhave for Team Magma's future.
\bWill you come with me on this journey as well?\nCourtney.
